answer: An hostile operator running 43 aliases therefore needs 58 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in zenith, expire in velvet, and harbor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 84 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
